name: Paratus Armada Data Center
notes: Brakwater campus near Windhoek, Khomas; launched August 2022 (announced July 2022); N$123m investment; two separate colocation data halls (DC1, DC2) each supported by two energy-centre pairs; carrier-neutral; first and largest carrier-neutral data centre in Namibia; Paratus official page confirms service (A), launch details from New Era/Economist/ITWeb/TechCabal (B).

name: Telecom Namibia Infinitum Co-location
notes: Co-location service located in Telecom Namibia headquarters buildings, Windhoek (per-rack/per-rack-unit hosting, secure physical access) per official Infinitum product/FAQ pages (A for service); DataCenterMap lists 'Telecom Namibia Datacenter' at 10001 Luderitz Street, Windhoek (C for facility address); discrete facility specifics (building plans/ECC/power) not yet published.

name: MTC Windhoek Data Centre (lead)
notes: MTC advertised a Data Centre Administrator role based in Windhoek (closing 2026-08-13), indicating MTC operates a data centre in Windhoek; no public colo product page/facility record found - operator/network lead only per methodology; keep as C until named facility evidence.

name: University of Namibia (UNAM) data centre (lead)
notes: Aggregator (Data Center Platform) listing of a UNAM data centre in Windhoek; unverified institutional facility - C lead only, requires official/UNAM corroboration.

name: Swakopmund Equiano Cable Landing Station (Telecom Namibia / Paratus)
developer: Telecom Namibia and Paratus Group (for Google Equiano)
notes: Swakopmund, Erongo; Equiano landed 2022-07-01; CLS co-built by Telecom Namibia and Paratus (building completed Sep 2021, internal fit Jan 2022), switched on June 2023; station inaugurated 2024-07-31 with 100G link to Johannesburg; WACS also lands at Swakopmund; SARSSy to interconnect via this station. Cable landing station, NOT customer colocation - recorded separately per methodology.

name: Huawei AI-ready National Data Centre (planned)
notes: July 2026 (ITWeb Africa): Huawei collaboration with Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security and Ministry of ICT on smart city solutions and an AI-ready national data centre, under a 10-year programme running to 2036; location/site not yet specified; keep as announced/planned until official strategic plan, budget vote, tender, award or site record appears.
